topic: Installation and operation of Polarized relay.
syllabus_extract: Installation and operation of Polarized relay.
specific_objectives: 24.1.1.1 Trainee will be able to explain the operation of Polarized relay and contacts.

training_aids.remarks: Refer to the master syllabus reference list
Objective: teach the syllabus extract for this lesson

practical: Demonstration of relay coil energization and contact closure; Safety: Ensure power is off before touching terminals; Instructor supervision: Monitor trainee observation of polarity effects.
intro_questions: What is the primary function of a relay?
How does a polarized relay differ from a standard relay?
Why is polarity critical in polarized relay operation?

development.content:
Construction of polarized relay
Permanent magnet assembly
Soft iron armature details
Contact arrangement types
Polarity sensitivity mechanism

Operation on positive polarity
Operation on negative polarity
Neutral position behavior
Contact movement sequence
Magnetic flux direction effects

Installation mounting requirements
Wiring polarity verification
Terminal identification marks
Secure connection techniques
Final operational check steps

summary_questions: Explain how reversing the coil current affects the armature position.
Describe the steps required to verify correct polarity during installation.
What happens to the contacts if the relay is operated without defined polarity?
home_assignment_question: Prepare a brief note comparing the installation requirements of a polarized relay versus a standard contactor to be discussed in LP 02.
